transcript: Speaker A: Most people can read in English, but when a native speaker speaks fast, they don't understand. It's not your fault. Real conversations are fast and full of emotion. That's where I come in. I'm Lura, your AI English tutor. We'll practice listening and speaking together every day, just like you would with a real person. I'll help you get used to real speed, correct your pronunciation, and guide you through mistakes gently. No stress, no pressure. Just natural English that gets better every day. And in just three weeks, you'll start understanding everything people say and speaking with real confidence.
